notes.title: Welcome to Home Renovator!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978716/e8da1752ad5c26186aa5f62892ef70e728674705.png

Hey Renovators,

We're thrilled to welcome you to our upcoming project, Home Renovator! As the makers of Hotel Renovator, we've poured our passion and dedication into crafting a game that we hope will captivate and inspire you just as much as our previous title.

Home Renovator will offer you the opportunity to unleash your creativity and design skills as you start your journey to transform houses into stunning homes. Whether you're a seasoned interior designer or a budding decorator, there's something for everyone in our immersive world of renovation and decoration.

[previewyoutube=kPvi6OCqaDw;full][/previewyoutube]
We're incredibly grateful for the support and enthusiasm we've received from our amazing community thus far, and we can't wait to start this new adventure with you. There’s still a long way to go before the release, but we are counting on your feedback and ideas to create an experience that you will enjoy.

To stay up-to-date with all the latest news, announcements, and community events related to Home Renovator, we invite you to join our Discord server. It's the perfect place to connect with fellow players and engage directly with the development team.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1795260/Home_Renovator/
